Name: Prize Machine Round 2
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[u][size=6][b]Prize Machine Round 2[/b][/size][/u]

This is a content pack for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24982]Prize Machine Custom Prizes (Framework)[/url] mod, and that mod needs to be installed for this pack to work.

This pack adds another round of 24 prizes to the Prize Machine in the Mayor's house, occupying slots 32-55, with a random high value item being awarded from prize number 56 onwards.

This is how the prize machine will work with this mod installed...
[list]
[*][b]Prizes 1-31: [/b]The regular prizes from the vanilla game, see the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Prize_Ticket]Prize Ticket wiki page[/url] here.
[*][b]Prizes 32-54: [/b]The prizes added by this mod. You can expect a similar pattern to the first round but with slightly more valuable/powerful/rare items. Many slots choose from a pool of multiple items and are awarded in variable quantities.
[*][b]Prize 55:[/b] The final reward of round 2. You can either let the game choose from a small pool of highly sought-after items for you, or you can choose from an expanded list via the config menu (read more below).
[*][b]Prizes 56+: [/b]One item from a pool of 25 valuable items, randomly chosen.
[*][b]Prize 66[/b]: Something cursed!
[*][b]Prize 100:[/b] Something celebratory!
[/list]
I'm not going to spoil the rewards, but some things you can expect are seeds for a rare crop, some help with hard-to-find items for CC bundles, a rare item of clothing, the occasional item from late game areas, and a very rare item to mark the end of round 2.


[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley and SMAPI.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24982]Prize Machine Custom Prizes (Framework)[/url] mod. Please use v1.2.3 or later of this mod.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] if you wish to choose the final prize manually.
[*]Install this mod (extract it to your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder)
[/list]
It is safe to add/remove this pack at any time. You can also disable the framework mod from the in-game config menu, if you do not wish to uninstall the mod completely.



[b][size=3]CONFIG OPTIONS FOR THE FINAL PRIZE! (READ CAREFULLY)[/size][/b]
If you have installed GMCM you can choose the reward you want to receive for the final prize of round 2 (prize #55).

[b][i]You cannot access this config option from the main menu! You have to access it [/i]after [i]you have loaded your[/i] [/b][i][b]savegame![/b]
[/i]After loading a game, you can find the config menu by pressing Esc, navigating to the Options tab, scrolling to the bottom of the menu and clicking on "Mod Options". You will then need to find the config for the framework mod (not this content pack) - it will appear in the list as "prizeMachineCustomPrizes".


[b]Choosing a reward for prize slot 55: [/b]There is a drop-down menu for "Prize '54'" with 11 items you can choose from (including some average items for those of you that don't want to earn such a high-value prize from the prize machine).

[u]You will need to actually click into the drop-down menu and choose you preferred item (even if the item you want is already the one displayed first in the list!).[/u] Don't forget to click save before returning to your game.

[b]
Letting this content pack choose for you:[/b] Simply never go into the config menu for this mod, and when you get to prize 55, the content pack will default to choosing one of three rare items for you. If you make a choice and later wish to revert to this default option, re-open the config menu for the framework mod while your savegame is loaded, click "Default" at the bottom of the window, make sure "Activate Mod" is checked, then click Save [i]without touching[/i] the drop-down menu.
[b]
[/b][b]
Turning custom prizes off entirely:[/b] Uncheck the "Activate Mod" option.



Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Tomokisan1/about-me?gameId=1303]Tomokisan1[/url] for the Framework mod, and for all their help getting this up and running. If you have any thoughts about item selection/balance or wish to make an item request for the final prize pool, please let me know.
